items.title: Mahalia Jackson Interview, 1954-06
items.q: Oh, is it in there, Ray? No. Well, okay.

ctx.x: The days of our years are three scores in ten, and if by reason of strength they be four years, yet is their strength labor and sorrows, for it is soon cut off and we fly away. Who knoweth the power of thine angry? Even according to thy fears, so is thy wrath. So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom. Return, O Lord, hallowed, and let it repent thee concerning thy servant. O satisfy us early with thy mercy, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days. Make us glad according to the…

I was, oh, maybe, say, ten years old. And I was glad to get that because it helped to meet the obligation at home. And then we, I got another job doing laundry work and they wouldn't pay you no more than a dollar and a half a day for that. Of course, that was good money to get a dollar and a half a day in the South. And, uh, I worked, went to school, and had many other activities as a child would have, grown pigments that the church would give. And most of them would be on top of the levee near the Mississippi…
